title: כשנופל שער — האדמה באמת רועדת
summary: Footquakes: a seismometer ~500 m from Camp Nou recorded every Barcelona goal in the 6–1 vs PSG (8 Mar 2017), the 95' winner about twice as big; how a seismometer works (inertial mass on a soft spring), why synchronised jumping adds up while random jumping cancels, frequency fingerprints of a city (metro 20–40 Hz, traffic 8–12 Hz, goals 1–6 Hz, concert songs ~2 Hz; Díaz et al. 2017), P vs S waves and Israel's TRUAA early warning, magnitude as a ×10 scale (Beast Quake ~M2 vs 1927 Jericho M6.2).
